verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1970 (UK).

notes.text:
Gatefold sheet cover with polythene outer sleeve that has "Family Anyway" printed on it.
RSX printed above Reprise logo, bottom centre inner gatefold, with 9005 below logo.
No "Distributed by Kinney Record Group Ltd." below Warner Bros. Records Ltd, bottom left of left inner gatefold.
Catalog # RSX 9005 printed on labels and sleeve but with K-54002 stamped in runouts.

A-side recorded live at Fairfields Hall, London
B-side recorded at Olympic Sound Studio.

Produced for Bradgate Bush Ltd.
A Warner Bros. Records Ltd. Recording
DUKESLODGE / CARLIN

Picture 'Mortars With Explosive Projectiles' courtesy of Biblioteca Ambrosiana, Milan
